candidates.title: Home Intro Split Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home_intro screen into a split stage layout featuring a live desktop interaction preview and quick-start actions.
candidates.why: The finish step has the highest drop-off rate (31.3%) and long mean completion times (5815s), while users report post-onboarding confusion regarding pet controls.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your desktop screen! Use quick keyboard shortcuts or right-click to interact anytime.

components.text: Right-click your pet to bring up interactions, hide, or change settings.

guard.reason: Redesigns home_intro layout within onboarding while preserving required functionality.

candidates.score_note: Finish has the largest drop-off (31.3%), but finish redesign tests show inconsistent historical wins (+2.2% avg).

candidates.title: Desktop Quick Controls Guide Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new screen, new_desktop_guide, before completion to demonstrate basic desktop controls and visibility toggles.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding.

new_desktop_guide.headline: How to Interact with Your Pet
new_desktop_guide.body: Learn the essential shortcuts to summon, move, and talk with your pet directly on your desktop taskbar and screen.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a new desktop guide screen within onboarding without skipping required steps.

candidates.score_note: Target step drops 31.3% and users report issues, but adding a new screen requires release and historically performed poorly (-1.9%).

candidates.title: Carousel Friend Picker Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen pick_friend into a full carousel layout with animated pet previews and badge traits.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 25.5% drop-off rate and a high median duration of 89s, indicating decision friction when picking a pet.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Perfect Companion
pick_friend.body: Swipe through available pets to preview their animations and unique behaviors.

guard.reason: Redesigns pet selection screen while preserving the core job of choosing a pet.

candidates.score_note: Adoption loses 25.5% of users; past adoption redesigns yielded modest +1.7% lift with mixed evidence.

candidates.title: Voice and Sound Preview Step Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a dedicated voice preview step, new_sound_check, inside the adoption flow so users can sample pet sounds before adopting.
candidates.why: Adoption requires deeper engagement; providing interactive feedback builds attachment before finalizing adoption details.

new_sound_check.headline: Test Your Pet's Voice
new_sound_check.body: Listen to your pet's greetings and sound effects before making it official.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a sound preview step within onboarding without removing required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has notable friction, but introducing new flow steps requires a new release and evidence for new flows is thin.

candidates.title: Two-Column Path Choice Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign choose_path into a structured two-column layout contrasting preset companion path vs custom pet path.
candidates.why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path with a wide disparity between median (8s) and mean (514s) time spent.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Adoption Journey
choose_path.body: Pick a ready-to-adopt companion or create your custom pet from scratch.

guard.reason: Redesigns choose_path while continuing to offer both preset adoption and custom creation.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path loses 23.8%, but past choose_path layout changes showed no clear effect (+1.2% over 2 tests).

candidates.title: Centered Sign-In Layout with Mascot Reassurance
candidates.change: Change sign_in screen to a centered layout featuring a pet mascot component and simplified account connection buttons.
candidates.why: Sign-in drops 23.1% of users, and 8 support tickets cited pets missing/reset when signing in with wrong or duplicate credentials.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Companion to Cloud
sign_in.body: Sign in to securely sync your pet across sessions so you never lose your progress.

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign of sign_in screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Strong alignment between sign-in drop-off (23.1%) and 8 support tickets; layout change carries moderate confidence.

candidates.title: Clear Desktop Visibility Instructions Copy
candidates.change: Update headline and body on home_intro to explicitly explain how to unhide and invoke the pet on the desktop screen.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted pet not showing on desktop or users not knowing how to reveal the pet window.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: If your pet doesn't appear immediately, check your system tray or press Ctrl+Shift+P to bring them forward.

guard.reason: Updates home_intro copy with helpful instructions without violating base rules.

candidates.score_note: Target step drops 31.3% with support tickets confirming confusion; copy-only change is low cost (2).

candidates.title: Account Binding Safety Hint
candidates.change: Add a prominent hint below the sign-in form clarifying that signing in links your current pet creation directly to your primary email.
candidates.why: 8 emails reported lost or reset pets after re-authenticating, showing account linking ambiguity during sign in.

sign_in.hint: Signing in binds your adopted pet to this account permanently. Use your primary login to avoid duplicate accounts.

guard.reason: Adds informative account hint to sign_in within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High evidence from 8 support emails and 23.1% drop, but hint changes have consistently shown negative or zero effect across tests.

candidates.title: Interactive Waiting Progress Mascot
candidates.change: Add an animated mascot asset and progress timer component to the waiting screen while desktop engines initialize.
candidates.why: Home initialization stage takes median 201s and mean 2336s, causing 18.7% drop-off while waiting.

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Sandbox...
waiting.body: We are getting your companion's home ready. This only takes a short moment!

guard.reason: Adds mascot and real wait progress indicator to waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Home initialization has drop-off, but 5 previous tests on home wait_info yielded no meaningful effect (+0.7%).

candidates.title: Official Adoption Certificate Stamp Incentive
candidates.change: Add a verified adoption badge component and celebratory headline to adoption_certificate to enhance ownership feeling.
candidates.why: Creating emotional connection on adoption certificate increases commitment through remaining sign-in and completion steps.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Verified!
adoption_certificate.body: Congratulations! Your companion is officially registered and ready to move onto your desktop.

guard.reason: Enhances adoption certificate design while maintaining official verification badge.

candidates.score_note: Target step adoption loses 25.5%; adding badge incentive is low-to-moderate effort with reasonable expectation.

picked: Centered Sign-In Layout with Mascot Reassurance
